subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

The poster was make by the hard-working students of class nine.
solution:
The correct answer is **'was make'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given statement, the error lies in the part** 'was make'**.
 
• The statement is in passive voice and simple past tense form.
 
• The structure of the simple past tense form of passive voice is: **Subject + was/were + V₃** **+ by + Object.**
 
 
• **For Example - **A letter **was written** by him.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct verb will be **'was made'.

 ​**

**Correct statement: ***The poster** was made** by the hard-working students of class nine.*
